integrity: Theorem follows from the stated combinatorial bijections, exact finite checks and the published bipartite-edge-cover counting hardness theorem; no independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite pure chromatic complexes with explicitly listed facets; secrecy events potentially observable with a suitable atomic valuation, not necessarily definable in a fixed valuation. Exact counting, not approximation or epistemic model checking. Older specialized priority not ruled out.
title: A two-to-three-agent counting threshold for effective simplicial secrecy events
